{"implementation": "def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    threshold = case['utility_threshold']
    node_map = {}
    children = {}
    for n in nodes:
        nid = n['id']
        node_map[nid] = n
        par = n['parent']
        if par is not None:
            children.setdefault(par, []).append(nid)
    # initial queue: descending depth, stable node ID order
    queue = sorted(node_map.keys(), key=lambda x: (-node_map[x]['depth'], x))
    removed = set()
    visit_order = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(queue):
        nid = queue[i]
        i += 1
        if nid in removed:
            continue
        visit_order.append(nid)
        node = node_map[nid]
        # check if leaf
        child_list = children.get(nid, [])
        is_leaf = all(cid in removed for cid in child_list)
        if is_leaf:
            if node['removable'] and node['utility'] <= threshold:
                removed.add(nid)
                parent_id = node['parent']
                if parent_id is not None and parent_id not in removed:
                    queue.append(parent_id)
    retained = [nid for nid in node_map if nid not in removed]
    return {"retained_ids": retained, "visit_order": visit_order}"}
